question: A and B can do a piece of work in 9 days and 15 days, respectively. If they work together, then the work will be completed in:
solution:
**Given:**

A and B can do a piece of work in 9 days and 15 days

**Solution:**

A can do piece of work in 9 days

B can do piece of work in 15 days

Total Work = LCM of (9 and 15) = 45

Efficiency of A = 45/9 = 5

Efficiency of B = 45/15 = 3

The work will be = 45/(3 + 5)
